==Overview==
'''April Fools 2026''', as the name suggests, is a joke event(now mode), and there's a few changes to some entities sounds and its designs, not just that but every 10 doors a random event happens, like "'''Let's go gambling'''" event, that makes that 3 [[M-60|M-60's]] spawn, also [[A-20ii]] is re-added, also being forcefully spawned at A-020.

==Door Events==
===I LIKE TRAINS===
* Force Spawns a couple of [[A-20i]]s

===ARE YOU KIDDING ME...?===
* Force Spawns a couple of [[M-7]]s

===LET'S GO GAMBLING!===
* Force Spawns a couple of [[M-60]]s

===HERE COMES THE SUN===
* Force Spawns a couple of [[E-10]]s

==={Random Number} MAX HEALTH===
* Increases or Decreases the player's max Health

==={Random Number}X SPEED===
* Increases or Decreases the Player's Max Speed

===BONK===
* Does around 10-20 damage

===I THINK THE HINGES RUSTED===
* Breaks every hiding spot in the main room


==Trivia==
* The game was renamed to "[PEAKING] room lost recording demoted" for the event
* like the Perfection Events, every shadow entity from the [[Shadow Challenge]] and the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] have a chance of invading your run.
* your sprint speed is increased by a LOT, tho it only lasts around 4 seconds.
* Crystal can be thrown, exploding a few seconds after landing.
** [https://youtu.be/Dg6kIvfQAog?si=_dVewH5vwtF8OJuQ Update Executive Teaser 8.8]
